_meta.purpose: Seed data for the Value-Hub Slice-0 equipment catalog. ~15 rackets only — strings / shoes / shuttles / bags / grips arrive in the Equipment track (Track 2) if Slice-0 survives its 4-week kill criterion.
_meta.schema: Each entry matches CatalogItem in lib/types.ts. `id` is stable and deterministic so re-runs are idempotent. `skillRange` follows the ACE stage scale [1-6] from lib/skills-data.ts.
_meta.sources: Each item carries non-affiliate retailer links (Yumo, RacquetGuys, BadmintonHQ) for now. Per Decision D in the plan, affiliateTag fields ship null in Slice-0; the field exists so flipping monetization on later is schema-free.
_meta.curation: Top ~5 popular models each from Yonex, Victor, Li-Ning. Hand-picked from public best-sellers + recreational-player community recommendations — not authoritative, will be revised once admin can edit the catalog (Track 2).
